text.$description: Semantic typography roles referencing core font.* tokens

face.$description: Typeface roles for UI text (font-1 Domine, font-2 Asap, font-3 IBM Plex Mono). Named face to avoid confusion with CSS font-style.

base.$description: text-face-base — default UI and body copy

mono.$description: text-face-mono — code, IDs, and tabular data

size.$description: Text size roles mapped to the core font.size scale (100–700)

xs.$description: text-size-xs — captions, badges, and compact labels

sm.$description: text-size-sm — secondary body and dense UI text

lg.$description: text-size-lg — emphasized body and small headings

3xl.$description: text-size-3xl — page titles — largest core step

leading.$description: Line-height roles mapped to core font.height (100–700)

xs.$description: text-leading-xs — tight leading for the smallest text

sm.$description: text-leading-sm — compact leading for labels and captions

md.$description: text-leading-md — standard leading for short UI text

lg.$description: text-leading-lg — relaxed leading for readable paragraphs

2xl.$description: text-leading-2xl — wide leading for large headings

letterSpacing.$description: Letter-spacing roles mapped to core font.spacing (Figma Semantic: 400–700)

xs.$description: text-letterSpacing-xs — tightest tracking for compact UI

sm.$description: text-letterSpacing-sm — default tracking for body and controls

md.$description: text-letterSpacing-md — open tracking for larger UI text

lg.$description: text-letterSpacing-lg — widest tracking for display and headings
